Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. We create the processes and conditions that enable high performance across teams and help Stripe scale with focus and discipline.

We partner closely with the CMO, Marketing and Sales Development leadership team to define strategy, lead operational planning, and steward execution across global programs.

Our work spans cross-functional efforts that are critical to Stripe’s growth. From delivering strategic insights and frameworks to leading complex initiatives, we focus on what moves the needle most for the business. We care about results, not activity, and we have fun doing it. If you like hard problems, are analytical, and are an amazing teammate, we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  •  Drive our annual strategic plan and operating plan, working in partnership with our CMO and marketing leadership team to define our must-wins, build plans to win, and allocate our resources to deliver on the plan.
  • Define our most critical OKRs that instill transparent, data-driven accountability for delivering our strategy to Stripe leadership.
  • Quarterback an agile, automated, data-driven reporting process and tool to manage OKRs.

  • Lead content on behalf of Marketing and Sales Dev for all monthly/quarterly business reviews, in close partnership with Finance, GTM, and Corporate Operations.
  • Use data to tell a compelling story and drive alignment on where we’re winning and where we need to focus.
  • Leverage an AI-first approach to aggressively automate marketing reporting.
  • Independently scope and lead strategic programs to solve high-impact problems. This includes developing frameworks, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring execution drives measurable outcomes.
  • Bring clarity to ambiguity. You’ll navigate complexity, distill insight from noise, resolve issues quickly, and empower teams to make smart, confident decisions.
  • Drive analysis and research that will help inform Stripe’s overall strategy and help us make the right long-term decisions.
  • Work directly with senior leaders across the company and with cross-functional partners to accelerate progress, solve hard scaling initiatives, and incubate new programs.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10 years of experience in consulting, strategy and operations, business operations, product strategy, product management, or similar roles with exposure to both business and technical skills
  • Experience working in highly cross-functional settings, and in a role that spans strategy, analysis, and operations in a fast-paced environment
  • Critical and first-principles thinking, with the ability to zoom out to the most important questions 
  • Passion for digging deep into data to diagnose business issues and solve problems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to speak to leaders across teams including product, engineering, analytics, sales, and partnerships

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience working directly with C-level executives and their direct reports
  • Background in marketing a strong plus
  • Experience navigating large data sets and/or SQL

About Polygon Labs

Polygon Labs is a global blockchain payments company building and operating infrastructure to move money instantly, reliably, and at internet scale, with the mission to move all money onchain. It is building the Polygon Open Money Stack, an open and integrated stack of services and technologies to instantly and reliably move money anywhere, and put it to work. Its infrastructure has facilitated trillions of dollars in onchain value transfer and supported millions of transactions daily for some of the globe's largest banks, fintechs, enterprises, and consumer applications.

About the Role

As fintechs and financial institutions integrate the Polygon Open Money Stack, the quality of the integration experience increasingly shapes how quickly partners reach production. Polygon operates as a US-regulated payments platform, licensed in 48 states through 37 money transmitter licenses and 11 exemptions, and our partner base is growing.

Today, many partner integration questions are routed to Engineering. This slows product development and leads to the same questions being answered repeatedly. The Technical Solutions Engineer will own the technical experience of building on Polygon: API and integration documentation, the integration path, technical support during the sales process, and bringing signed partners to production.

Our standard is a best-in-class developer experience in payments, where a capable developer, including one working with AI coding tools, can integrate with minimal direct support.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Account Management & Support.

Responsibilities

  • API and integration documentation: Own the accuracy, completeness, and clarity of Polygon’s API and integration documentation, and keep it current as the platform evolves.

  • Self-serve integration: Build quickstarts, sample code, and reference architectures that enable developers, including those using AI coding tools, to integrate independently.

  • Technical expertise: Serve as the primary technical resource in sales conversations alongside Business Development and throughout partner integrations, then document solutions so they’re reusable.

  • Partner go-live: Lead signed partners through requirements intake, provisioning following KYB and KYC approval, sandbox testing, webhook configuration, and go-live validation, in partnership with Integration Delivery.

  • Platform knowledge: Develop deep expertise across ramps and bank rails, wallets and accounts, custodial and non-custodial flows, virtual accounts, deposit addresses, cross-chain movement, and webhooks.

  • Demos and enablement: Build sample applications and demo environments that support Business Development and Sales.

  • Product feedback: Identify gaps in the API and integration experience, and turn them into clear, prioritized recommendations for Product and Engineering.

  • Automation: Use AI and internal tooling to streamline onboarding, provisioning, and frontline support.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with US payments, including ACH, RTP, wire transfers, card networks, or equivalent rails, and a working understanding of settlement and reconciliation.

  • Experience in one of the following:

    • Leading customer API integrations from kickoff to production at a payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure company

    • Owning API documentation, SDKs, or developer support at an API-first payments company

  • Strong API and troubleshooting skills, including reading logs, debugging webhooks, and reasoning through authentication and retry behavior, with tools such as Postman, Bruno, or Datadog

  • Excellent technical writing, with the ability to document complex systems clearly for external developers

  • Regular use of AI tools to build, document, and automate work

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the platform and documentation are actively evolving

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with stablecoins or digital assets, particularly wallets and onchain settlement

  • Experience at an early-stage company, building processes or programs from the ground up

  • Enough coding ability to build demo applications

  • Experience with documentation platforms such as Mintlify

  • Familiarity with KYB and KYC tooling

Why Join

Cross-border payments remain slow, expensive, and opaque. Polygon is bringing regulated fiat access, wallets, and onchain settlement together into one integrated stack, and partners are building on it today. In this role, you’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business Development leadership and set the standard for how partners integrate with Polygon.

About Kamino

Kamino's mission is to create liquidity and utility for every asset. We want the world's best investments to be available through the financial platforms people already trust, and we want investors to be able to borrow against what they own when they need liquidity, instead of having to sell.

Today, the most valuable assets in the world are often the least useful to own. Trillions of dollars sit in private markets, behind high minimums and holding periods that can run for years. Tokenization is starting to move these assets onto shared, programmable infrastructure, but putting an asset onchain is only the first step. To be useful, it still needs distribution, compliance, servicing, credit and liquidity.

Kamino already runs the credit and liquidity engine at scale. It is the largest credit protocol on Solana and the largest credit platform for real-world assets onchain, with more than $650 billion in cumulative transaction volume and more than $20 billion in loans originated.

Now we are building the rest of that system for institutions. Kamino recently named Yieldstreet co-founder Michael Weisz as CEO and is building a new HQ in New York, alongside the asset managers and financial platforms that will shape this market. Almost none of that market exists yet, and we intend to build it.

Build the team and management systems for Kamino's next stage of growth.

The role

Kamino is hiring a Head of People to build the team and management systems for our next stage of growth. As our senior People leader, you will work directly with the CEO and leadership team across hiring, organization design, performance, compensation and global People Operations.

This is a function-building role with substantial hands-on ownership. You will personally lead critical searches, coach managers and handle sensitive employee matters while establishing the systems that help people succeed. You will build the foundations first, then the People team required to scale them across our New York office and global organization.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and lead the People function. Own People strategy, workforce planning and budget. Advise leadership on organization design and build the team and specialist support Kamino needs as it scales.

  • Own hiring outcomes. Lead recruiting across senior, technical and commercial roles, personally running critical searches. Establish a clear hiring bar and an effective assessment and closing process.

  • Strengthen management and performance. Coach leaders and build practical systems for feedback, development, promotion and accountability. Handle difficult people decisions with sound judgment and discretion.

  • Help people succeed at Kamino. Build onboarding, development and retention practices that support a high-performing team and connect the New York office with the global organization.

  • Build compensation and rewards. Establish salary structures, performance incentives, long-term participation and benefits that support consistent hiring and reward decisions.

  • Run global People Operations. Own the systems and processes behind employment, payroll and benefits coordination, and employee relations. Work with Legal and specialist partners across jurisdictions, protecting confidential information and keeping operations proportionate to Kamino’s scale.

What you bring

  • 10+ years across People, Talent or Human Resources, including building or materially scaling a People function as a high-growth company grew from approximately 30–50 people to more than 150.

  • Experience advising a founder, CEO or leadership team while remaining hands-on. You can translate company plans into organization design, hiring priorities and management capacity.

  • End-to-end recruiting leadership across senior, technical and commercial roles, with personal ownership of critical searches and demonstrated improvements in hiring quality and speed.

  • Experience strengthening managers and building practical performance, development and promotion systems. You communicate clearly and give direct feedback with empathy and respect.

  • Experience building compensation and benefits programs, including salary structures, performance incentives and long-term participation.

  • Hands-on People Operations and employee-relations experience, strong knowledge of U.S. and New York employment practices, and experience supporting international teams through local entities, employers of record and specialist counsel.

  • Discretion and analytical judgment: you use People data to identify problems and evaluate results, handle sensitive matters carefully and act independently with urgency.

  • Daily fluency with AI tools across recruiting and People operations, with rigorous output verification and protection of confidential information.

STRONGLY PREFERRED

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, digital assets, AI or another complex technical company.

  • Direct familiarity with digital assets or onchain financial markets.

  • Experience building a senior team in New York while supporting a global organization.

  • Experience designing equity, token or other long-term incentive programs.

Working at Kamino

You will work directly with senior leadership and partner closely with managers across the company. Finance and Legal will be important partners on compensation, benefits, employment structures, and sensitive employee matters. This is a senior function-building role with a substantial hands-on component. You will remain close to the work, from critical searches and manager coaching through compensation design and global People Operations. Some important work will cross time zones, and the role may involve occasional travel for company gatherings. This is a full-time role based in New York City. We work together in the office four days per week. Kamino may provide immigration sponsorship for an exceptional candidate who meets the experience bar and can work from New York.

Compensation and benefits

The expected annual base salary range for this role is USD $200,000–$250,000. Kamino expects to offer a competitive package consisting of base salary, a performance-based bonus and long-term KMNO participation.
